name: Tiefling

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.description: You perceive Dim Light as Bright Light, without a separate range limit. This does not permit vision through Darkness.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: Know Thaumaturgy at character level 1 and cast it at will. Use the spellcasting ability chosen for your Fiendish Ancestry.

reviewNotes: Tiefling is classified as Fiend, not Humanoid, and is playable through one of its three required Fiendish Ancestry leaves. The Fiend classification applies to type-based targeting independent of alignment.
Ordinary mortal needs (breathing, food, and sleep) are explicitly defined by Tiefling Species. Fiend classification does not add a Humanoid type or import Outsider monster stat-block defaults.
Low-Light Vision supersedes the older 60-foot Darkvision; no automatic Sunlight Sensitivity is granted. Future specialized darkness-adapted ancestry remains a separate decision.
The three Ancestries retain distinct 50-percent damage resistance types and inherited spell progressions. Thaumaturgy is shared and its casting ability follows the chosen Ancestry.
No alignment restriction, automatic Infernal/Abyssal language, or required cultural Upbringing. Ability-score adjustments and comparative balance are deferred.
Historical 3.5e resistance 5 to cold/electricity/fire and Bluff/Hide bonuses remain research evidence rather than cumulative native benefits; optional Tiefling Ancestry variants remain deferred.
Additional spellcasting, creature-type targeting, and native character projector implementation remain later integration work; this JSON is the authoritative provisional rules baseline.
